description_expanded:
Seagrove

2-minute walk to Private Beach Access!

Private, heated pool!

Scenic gulf views via a fourth-floor wet bar

Outdoor kitchenette w/ natural gas grill

7 Bikes!

7 bedrooms, 7.5 bathrooms

6 parking spaces, including carport access

Magnolia Way by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Magnolia Way is four stories of style, comfort, and barefoot luxury. Watch the sunrise from the top-floor balcony, then take the private elevator down for a refreshing pool dip. You’re going to love Magnolia, where every morning feels like a treat. Beyond the heated private pool, the star of the show, the layout strikes a smart balance between lively gathering spaces and quiet corners to retreat. The main living level sits on the third floor, where the kitchen and living room take center stage. Large balcony doors pull in natural light, perfect for long meals, late conversations, and a steady rotation of snacks from the kitchen. Speaking of the kitchen, it’s ready for action.

An oversized island, top-tier appliances, and plenty of room to linger mean no one’s stuck cooking alone. Head upstairs to the fourth level for a favorite hangout: a wet bar, sweeping water views, and a balcony that earns its keep at sunset. Seven bedrooms and seven-and-a-half baths give everyone room to spread out and settle in. From the primary suite on the second floor to the private retreats up top, every bedroom comes with its own TV and luxe linens. Comfort is not optional here. Out back, the heated private pool anchors the outdoor scene. A poolside kitchenette and gas grill make it easy to drift from swimming to grilling without breaking the flow of the day. At Oversee 30A, we keep things easy—clean, comfortable homes paired with a local team that’s always nearby. Our offices are close, open seven days a week, with 24/7 support whenever you need it. Magnolia handles the wow factor. We’ll handle the rest. Overview: - 2 minute walk to Private Beach Access - Private heated pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - 7 Bedroom, 7.5 bath - Private elevator - Outdoor kitchenette w/ natural gas grill - Fourth-floor wet bar and gulf views - 7 Bikes - Two laundry closets - Foosball table - Wifi Overnight: SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath w/ double vanity, soaking tub, walk-in shower, TV - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, ensuite bathroom, shower/tub combo, TV - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, ensuite bathroom, shower/tub combo, TV THIRD FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, TV - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, private bathroom, shower only, TV FOURTH FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: King bed, ensuite bathroom, shower only, TV - Guest Bedroom: King bed, private bathroom, shower only, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
